page.overview:
Who is Hars Adislo?

Lieutenant Commander Hars Adislo was a Bolian male Starfleet officer. Adislo was the author of a paper on thermionic transconductance.

In 2374, Adislo attended the Nel Bato Conference where he first met Captain Jean-Luc Picard.

He visited the in 2375 for the reception celebrating the Evora becoming a Federation protectorate, where he met Picard again and inquired whether the captain had read his paper. Picard left without answering. ()
